messages:
Maria S: FYI Acme says their month-end invoice total doesn't match the dashboard. They see a duplicated 'slab' line on the invoice that's blowing up the total.
JJ (CS): Got account id and invoice pdf? any quick repro steps?
Maria S: acct_acme_42, attaching invoice link. Repro from customer: Dashboard -> Billing -> month=Feb shows plan tier Standard, tokens 1,230,000; invoice shows two identical 500k slab lines + 230k remainder which looks like double-counting the 500k slab.
Priya (Eng): Can you paste the invoice line items text and the exact cutoff window they used to close month?
Maria S: Lines: `Standard - 500,000 tokens - $A`
`Standard - 500,000 tokens - $A`
`Standard - 230,000 tokens - $B`. Cutoff used: 2024-02-28 23:59:59 UTC.
Alex C: tagging billing bot for exports: @billing-bot please pull metering logs for acct_acme_42 2024-02-28 00:00:00 -> 2024-03-01 00:00:00
billing-bot: logs queued, export id export_20240228_acme_42 (ETA ~3m) :gear:
JJ (CS): Did the customer change plan mid-month? plan changes can create split lines but shouldn't duplicate.
Maria S: They upgraded from Trial -> Standard on 2024-02-20 10:15 UTC. Dashboard shows expected split. Invoice is the odd one out.
Priya (Eng): My initial hunch: double aggregation due to backfill that overlapped cutoff. Can you share the aggregation query that feeds invoices?
Alex C: Query we run for invoice rollup (simplified):
```
SELECT account_id, tier, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_metering
WHERE ts >= '2024-02-01' AND ts < '2024-03-01'
GROUP BY account_id, tier;
```
Priya (Eng): Thanks. I'll run a filtered version locally for acct_acme_42 and also check for duplicate batch_ids. Also pinging infra if any backfills touched metering on Feb 28.
Finance Ops: We did run a scheduled partition backfill on Feb 28 23:55 that updated some metering shards (non-customer-facing patch). Could be related if the backfill inserted rows without dedupe flags.
Priya (Eng): Good catch. Repro plan: 1) fetch raw metering rows for acct_acme_42 between 2024-02-28 23:50 -> 2024-03-01 00:05, 2) check for duplicate batch_id or identical rows, 3) verify invoice-generator run timestamps and whether both runs were picked up.
JJ (CS): Customer wants an explanation and rough delta estimate. They reported an invoice delta of ~$120 but saw the duplicated slab which looks bigger.
Maria S: Customer-reported delta is 36500 tokens (not huge). The duplicated slab visually worries them because it amplifies perceived error.
Priya (Eng): Running quick local diff now... (2m)
Priya (Eng): Found duplicate metering rows with identical batch_id from original job and the backfill. Both sets were included in the rollup because the backfill didn't set the dedupe flag. Root cause: backfill/partition job omitted the dedupe marker causing aggregation to count same tokens twice.
Alex C: Can we do a targeted invoice re-run for acct_acme_42 and issue a corrected invoice?
Finance Ops: Yes — we can void & reissue a corrected invoice for a single account after the fix. Need approval from billing manager (cc @Lena). We'll also prepare a credit for the overcharged amount.
Priya (Eng): I'll push a patch to ensure backfill sets dedupe metadata and run a one-off dedupe in the metering store. After that we should re-run invoice generator only for acct_acme_42.
Maria S: ETA to customer?
Finance Ops: After patch deploy + one-off dedupe run it's ~4 hours to re-run generator, validate numbers, and issue new invoice. We'll flag it as 'corrected invoice' in the email and include a short explanation.
JJ (CS): Great — I'll update Acme with the timeline, note that we found a backfill overlap bug and that we're issuing a corrected invoice + credit.
Maria S: Please paste the final transaction id / reissued invoice link here when done so I can close the support ticket.
Priya (Eng): Will do. Opening internal postmortem and an action item to add guardrails so backfills set dedupe flag by default.
JJ (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup:
